        | sort 0 - rule_lastupdated

    | search "Policy Name" IN ($policy_name$)

    | rename policy_id as "Policy ID", rule_name as "Rule Name"  rule_state as "Rule State" rule_hitcount as "Rule Hit Counts" Cisco_Catalyst_Dataset.Cisco_Catalyst_ISE_TACACS_Policy_Rule_Hit.ise_tacacs_policy_rule_host  as "ISE Server"
    | search "Rule Name" IN ("$authorization_policy_hit_details$") 
    | eval policy_type="TACACS Policy" 
    | table "Rule Name", "Policy Name", "Policy ID", "Rule State", "Policy State", "Rule Hit Counts", "Policy Hit Counts", policy_type, "ISE Server"
        ] 
| where isnotnull("Rule Name") 
    AND isnotnull("Policy Name")

    AND isnotnull("Policy State") 
    AND isnotnull("Rule Hit Counts") 
    AND isnotnull("Policy Hit Counts") 
| where policy_type = "$policy_type$" 
| rename "Rule Name" as "Auth Policy Rule Name" "Policy Name" as "Policy Set Name" "Rule State" as "Authorization Policy State",

| table "ISE Server" "Policy ID", "Auth Policy Rule Name", "Policy Set Name", "Authorization Policy State", "Authentication Policy State", "Authorization Policy Hit Counts", "Authentication Policy Hit Counts"
